name: roadmap_priority
description: Priority labels for explicitly selected future-write roadmap contracts.

definitions.p0: Priority label with numeric rank 0; no urgency or deadline mapping is defined.
definitions.p1: Priority label with numeric rank 1; no urgency or deadline mapping is defined.
definitions.p2: Priority label with numeric rank 2; no urgency or deadline mapping is defined.
definitions.p3: Priority label with numeric rank 3; no urgency or deadline mapping is defined.
definitions.p4: Priority label with numeric rank 4; no urgency or deadline mapping is defined.
definitions.P0: Uppercase spelling of p0; readers normalise it to p0.
definitions.P1: Uppercase spelling of p1; readers normalise it to p1.
definitions.P2: Uppercase spelling of p2; readers normalise it to p2.
definitions.P3: Uppercase spelling of p3; readers normalise it to p3.
definitions.P4: Uppercase spelling of p4; readers normalise it to p4.

P0.note: Historical reports spell priorities in uppercase.

P1.note: Historical reports spell priorities in uppercase.

standard.none: Project-defined labels; no external standard is adopted.
